answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, clawed back after a replayed submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Work waits on the gale until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the vine of the next round. Reaching the nectar of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
